ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISNEW()),
OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Interview_Status__c), "Hired"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Interview_Status__c), "Rejected"),
CASE( Interview_Status__c, "New", 1, "Recruiter Screening", 2, "Shortlisted", 3, "Interviewing", 4, "Offered", 5, "Hired", 6, "Rejected", 7, 0 ) < CASE( PRIORVALUE(Interview_Status__c), "New", 1, "Recruiter Screening", 2, "Shortlisted", 3, "Interviewing", 4, "Offered", 5, "Hired", 6, "Rejected", 7, 0 ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Interview Status cannot move backward and cannot be changed after Hired or Rejected.
